deferredPortsAndRisks: Host-wide OS/driver interference and thermal telemetry are unavailable in the M08 kernel; active CPU samples therefore remain PARTIAL and cannot be promoted to VALID capability evidence.

The CPU reference path measures only allowlisted SHA-256 throughput/latency for exact caller-supplied fixture bytes. It does not discover hardware facts; exact non-synthetic M07 provenance remains caller/M07 authority.
No GPU, video/image codec, 3D, audio, provider/model SDK, sustained CPU, provider workflow or device execution is available; those paths return UNSUPPORTED/UNAVAILABLE without simulated measurements.
Persistence/CAS, production resource control, quality judges, rights/security engines and release decisions remain deferred by scope.
